title: Goldman Sachs, SocGen buy Rs 920 crore stake in Lenskart - The Economic Times
text:
Goldman Sachs and Societe Generale have jointly invested ₹920 crore to purchase a 1% stake in Lenskart Solutions, acquiring 65.21 lakh and 61.76 lakh shares priced at ₹725 each. Steadview Capital Management facilitated this by selling an equivalent number of shares, resulting in their stake decreasing from 3.31% to 2.58%. Following this, Lenskart’s stock slid approximately 4%, ending the day at ₹715.90.
